Agent Name: CelestialPhysics_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly identified the minimum perigee distance between the Earth and the Moon as 356,500 kilometers. According to astronomical data and the Wikipedia page for the Moon, the minimum perigee distance is approximately 363,300 kilometers (often rounded to 363,000 km or 364,000 km depending on the source, but definitely not 356,500 km). The value 356,500 km is significantly lower than the actual minimum perigee, leading to an underestimation of the distance and consequently an incorrect final result. While the subsequent calculations (pace, time division, rounding) were mathematically consistent with the wrong input, the root cause of the error lies in the factual verification of the distance in Step 1.
